title: Installing Packages
description: How to install and manage NuGet packages using the CLI, Visual Studio, and Rider.

data.text: You can install NuGet packages using the .NET CLI, Visual Studio Package Manager, or Rider. The CLI is the most portable option and works across all platforms.

data.title: CLI Installation
data.content: Install a package with the .NET CLI.

data.title: Package Manager Console
data.content: Install a package in Visual Studio.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `dotnet add package` in the CLI
Use Package Manager Console in Visual Studio
Packages are added to the project file
data.takeaway: Choose the tool that fits your workflow; they all achieve the same result.
